mostWorthwhile.text: Combining varied survivors with advancing ice made natural selection clear: inherited differences affect survival and reproduction across generations, rather than individuals changing by will.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the oasis and cold-adapted populations produced surviving lineages without much detail, making that connection less satisfying than the explanations around it.

surprise.text: The sheltered oasis clarified that migration requires both a usable route and a suitable destination, not just movement away from cold.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, though combining a sheltered oasis with cold-adapted populations was an abstract way to unite two distinct survival paths.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the surviving lineages reshape the world, especially because recovery includes both change and irreversible loss.
